Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor

Class KineticReactionDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.KineticReactionDiagnostics
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class KineticReactionDiagnostics extends Object implements Serializable
Reaction-timescale diagnostics for coupling KineticReaction models to transport.

The diagnostic compares the time required to consume the limiting reactant at the current local reaction rate with a caller-provided residence time. The resulting Damkohler number is a screening measure for whether chemistry is effectively frozen, competes with transport, or is fast relative to transport. It does not replace timestep-refinement or kinetic validation.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Team

  • Method Details

    • evaluate

      public static KineticReactionDiagnostics evaluate(KineticReaction reaction, SystemInterface system, int phaseIndex, double residenceTimeSeconds)
      Evaluate a kinetic reaction against a local transport residence time.

      The timescale estimate is directly meaningful for volume-basis rates. Catalyst-mass and catalyst-area rates are rejected because a reactor-specific catalyst loading or area is needed before a volumetric reactant-consumption timescale can be defined.

      Parameters:
      reaction - kinetic reaction
      system - initialized thermodynamic system
      phaseIndex - phase in which the reaction rate is evaluated
      residenceTimeSeconds - local transport residence time [s]
      Returns:
      immutable reaction/transport diagnostic
